text: 2) Stage 2: Three-Partition Consistency Graph (TPCG): The epistemic context at turn t is a three-partition graph Gt = (V, E, W) with V = VQ ∪ VM ∪ VC: query probes VQ = {q, qpara, qcf}; retrieved chunks VM = {m1, . . . , mk}; atomic claims VC = {c1, . . . , cJ} from dependency parsing of yt.

text: Edge Weights. All weights satisfy Wu,v ≥ 0: query-memory edges Wql,mi = max(0, cos(E(ql), ei)); memory-claim edges Wmi,cj = Pentail(cj | mi) ∈ [0, 1] via a DeBERTa-v3 cross-encoder; intra-memory weights attenuate contradiction:

text: where Pcontr ∈ [0, 1] is the cross-encoder contradiction score. When Pcontr → 1, the intra-memory edge collapses to zero without introducing illegal negative weights. Because entail- ment scores are directional, the memory–claim edges are symmetrized before spectral analysis:

text: 3) Stage 3: Spectral Laplacian Decomposition: Given ad- jacency matrix W ∈ R|V|×|V| ≥0, we define diagonal degree matrix Duu = ∑v∈V Wuv. For isolated nodes (du = 0, e.g., unsupported claims), we adopt the standard regularized spectral convention [17]:

verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Equation; isi berupa LaTeX

text: where Γ is the diagonal indicator matrix (Γuu = 1 if du > 0, else 0; not the all-ones matrix)—equivalently, the standard Moore–Penrose pseudo-inverse convention for D−1/2 written explicitly, with D−1/2 uu = 0 for du = 0. This guarantees that isolated claim vertices induce zero eigenvalues, directly forc- ing λ2 → 0 when claims disconnect from memory. Because Wu,v ≥ 0, Lsym is positive semi-definite with real eigenvalues 0 = λ1 ≤ λ2 ≤ · · · ≤ λ|V| ≤ 2.

image_caption: Fig. 2. Detection Performance (measured on the oracle-free replication pilot, 5,391 held-out turns). (a) SRCA density by class from actual test-turn scores. (b) ROC curves: full feature pipeline (AUROC 0.871; shown via its monotone SRCA projection, 0.921), NLI-only baseline (0.889), embedding-margin baseline (0.500). On the precision–recall frontier (area under the PR curve), RECONTRACE attains 0.776 vs. 0.662/0.614 for the NLI/embedding baselines.
